_doc: Meshy run 2026-10-28 (owner credits ~1000; nothing else may spend them). The main session submits; save every result as <downloads>/<id>.bvh (text-to-motion) or <id>.glb (text-to-3D) and run: python tools/anim/meshy_pipeline.py all --downloads <dir>. Motions: mode prime, BVH export, 30 fps. Models: append style_suffix to every model prompt (docs/plans/ART_DIRECTION.md). Order = priority; stop when credits run out.
style_suffix: medieval, grounded stylised realism, realistic proportions, hand-painted PBR textures, muted natural palette

motions.prompt: Medieval woodcutter splitting a log on a chopping block with a two-handed axe: feet planted shoulder width and never moving, raise the axe overhead, swing straight down onto the block, small recoil, lift again. Seamless loop, same pose at start and end.

Blacksmith hammering hot metal on an anvil with a one-handed hammer in the right hand, left hand holding tongs on the anvil, feet planted, two strikes per cycle with a small rest between. Seamless loop.

Farmer kneeling on one knee in a field row, digging a small hole in the soil with both hands, dropping seeds, covering them; hands touch the ground surface but never go below it; stays in place. Seamless loop.
motions.replaces: Dig And Plant Seeds / plant_kneeling (IK reach pops)

motions.prompt: Woman standing at a wooden wash tub at waist height, bent slightly forward, scrubbing cloth on a washboard with both hands, feet planted. Seamless loop.
Person standing at a cauldron stirring with a long wooden spoon held in both hands, slow circular stirring, feet planted, upright back. Seamless loop.
Villager sweeping the floor with a long broom, short sweeps left to right, feet planted, in place. Seamless loop.
Miner swinging a pickaxe overhead into a rock wall in front of him, two-handed grip, feet planted wide, strike and pull back. Seamless loop.
motions.replaces: no mining clip (WP-13 underground post miners)

motions.prompt: Carpenter standing at a workbench at waist height, holding a nail with the left hand and hammering it with a hammer in the right hand, feet planted. Seamless loop.
Person lying on their back asleep on a bed, slow breathing, slight shifts, arms relaxed at the sides. Seamless loop.
Person waking up lying on a bed, sitting up, swinging the legs over the side and standing up next to the bed.
Person sitting on a bench eating bread with the right hand and holding a bowl in the left hand, small bites, chewing. Seamless loop.
Farmer sitting on a low three-legged stool milking a cow, both hands squeezing alternately at knee height, back slightly bent. Seamless loop.
Farmer mowing grass with a long scythe, wide horizontal swings from right to left, standing in place with feet planted. Seamless loop.
Laborer walking forward pushing a wheelbarrow, both hands gripping the handles low at hip height, steady walking pace.
Bard standing and playing a lute held across the chest, right hand strumming, left hand on the neck, gentle sway. Seamless loop.
Person kneeling down on both knees from standing, joining hands in prayer, holding still.
